notes: SURNAME OPEN QUESTION (research 2026-07-03, unresolved): her parents are given in the export as "Robert Doane" and "Elizabeth Bellin," but Done (a genuine Cheshire gentry surname, the Done family of Utkinton) and Doane (a well-documented, unrelated Cape Cod/Eastham Massachusetts family) are two different surnames. No source found connects an Elinor Done/Doane of Frodsham, Cheshire to a Robert Doane/Done and Elizabeth Bellin — possibly another cross-family name conflation, though less clear-cut than the Crosby/Brigham title issue on this same line. Needs direct Cheshire parish-register or Done-family-pedigree verification.
